verdict.rationale: SerpApi's integrations page tells users to "install the library for your language" and lists the official Python SDK serpapi-python as Available. The official GitHub repo google-search-results-python shows working SDK usage, with GoogleSearch().get_dict() and Bing, Baidu and Yahoo classes. That repo is marked as soon to be deprecated in favor of serpapi-python, so an official migration path exists. Missing for 10: evidence of official SDKs in languages beyond Python, usage docs for the newer serpapi-python library itself, and independent hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
